rules.v: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
rules.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
rules.n: Recruiting agencies need a licence and a deposit; they must compensate workers if the work or pay differs from the agreement, but the Act does not make them jointly liable with the employer as such.

rules.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
rules.v: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
rules.n: Service charges are capped; under the 2015 'free visa, free ticket' decision employers in Malaysia and six Gulf states pay visa and air ticket and agencies may charge at most NPR 10,000; zero cost under government schemes.

rules.v: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
rules.n: A labor approval requires an employment contract with stated minimum terms, attested where required.

rules.v: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
rules.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
rules.n: Orientation training is compulsory before labor approval; workers pay a fee to approved training centers.

rules.v: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
rules.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.n: Contributions to the Foreign Employment Welfare Fund and compulsory insurance are conditions of approval; the Fund pays for death, injury and repatriation and supports families.

rules.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.v: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
rules.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
rules.n: The Act requires labor attachés in countries with large numbers of Nepali workers (more than 5,000).

rules.v: A specialized body at home can award compensation to workers against recruiters (and employers abroad) for breaches during recruitment or employment
rules.vi: Badan khusus di dalam negeri dapat memberi ganti rugi kepada pekerja terhadap perekrut (dan majikan asing) atas pelanggaran selama rekrutmen atau kerja
rules.n: The Department can order compensation against agencies and the Foreign Employment Tribunal tries offenses under the Act and can order compensation.

rules.f: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
rules.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
rules.v: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
rules.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
rules.n: Rules on domestic work abroad have applied to women only: a minimum age of 30 (2012), then 24 (2015), and suspensions of domestic work in Gulf destinations since 2016, with conditions set in 2020. Current status is to be confirmed with the Department of Foreign Employment.
rules.s: Guidelines for sending domestic workers 2074 (2017); Kathmandu Post 2015–2018; HRW 2021

rules.v: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
rules.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
rules.n: Reintegration services run through the Foreign Employment Board and local governments under policy and programs; no statutory duty was found in the Act.

rules.f: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
rules.fi: Tempat penampungan bagi pekerja bermasalah di luar negeri
rules.v: Shelters or safe houses are run at some missions by policy or practice
rules.vi: Tempat penampungan dikelola di sebagian perwakilan berdasarkan kebijakan atau praktik
rules.n: Safe houses are run at some missions with support from the Foreign Employment Welfare Fund.

rules.v: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
rules.vi: Saluran resmi ada tetapi tidak 24 jam, atau hanya di sebagian perwakilan
rules.n: The Department of Foreign Employment and the Foreign Employment Board run helplines; round-the-clock operation is not confirmed.

rules.v: Legal assistance is funded by policy or discretionary funds
rules.vi: Bantuan hukum dibiayai berdasarkan kebijakan atau dana diskresioner
rules.n: The Welfare Fund and missions provide assistance, but no statutory legal aid for proceedings abroad was found.

rules.v: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
rules.vi: Langkah khusus gender bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program
rules.n: The Foreign Employment Policy 2012 has a section on women workers; the Act has no specific provision on violence.

rules.fi: Kematian di luar negeri: pemulangan dan pemeriksaan
rules.v: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
rules.vi: Pemulangan dan santunan kematian diberikan, tanpa jalur untuk memastikan sebab kematian
rules.n: The Welfare Fund pays compensation to families and repatriates remains; causes of death are rarely examined after return.

rules.fi: UU antiperdagangan orang yang mencakup kerja
rules.v: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
rules.vi: UU khusus memidanakan perdagangan orang untuk kerja paksa dan menyediakan bantuan, pelindungan atau restitusi bagi korban
rules.n: Dedicated Act criminalizes trafficking and transportation, with rehabilitation and compensation for victims.

rules.n: Free visa, free ticket policy.

rules.v: Covered by statute

laws.tp: Employer-paid visa and ticket for seven destinations; capped service charge

decisions.nm: Order to use the Foreign Employment Welfare Fund for repatriation
decisions.pe: During COVID-19, many Nepali workers lost their jobs abroad and could not pay for a flight home. The Supreme Court ordered the government to use the welfare fund that workers pay into to bring them back.
decisions.pi: Selama COVID-19, banyak pekerja Nepal kehilangan pekerjaan di luar negeri dan tidak mampu membeli tiket pulang. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah memakai dana kesejahteraan yang dibayar para pekerja untuk memulangkan mereka.

decisions.nm: Directive to enforce the “free visa, free ticket” policy
decisions.pe: Nepal decided in 2015 that employers abroad should pay for workers’ visas and tickets, but agencies kept charging workers. The Supreme Court told the government to make the rule work.
decisions.pi: Nepal memutuskan pada 2015 bahwa majikan di luar negeri harus menanggung visa dan tiket pekerja, tetapi agen tetap menarik biaya dari pekerja. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah agar aturan itu benar-benar dijalankan.
